items.title: Rewrite source 10 (core action) as v2 with the new writing rules
items.description: Merlijn feedback 2026-06-04 while reading: strip jargon ('trust artifact', 'crystallization', 'single-player utility'); two registers only (visionary-plain or concrete); fix overstated claim (on-treatment oncology appointments fire ~weekly, so the summary already has near-weekly cadence and an accumulating record; the frequency gap is between visits, lighter segments, post-treatment); downgrade '20 interviews = hard requirement' to strongly-preferred evidence, not a gate; label ideation as ideation. He may add more feedback as he reads; produce v2 after.
items.notes: ADDED 2026-06-04 (Merlijn while reading): structure v2 around the three eigenquestions (which core actions / which problems / who is the primary user); use the frequency reframe (disease is top-of-mind daily; the question is which jobs fire and where we can support, see source 11); follower-side 'send something thoughtful' is a candidate core action but weaker (reply in the loop, not the opening move); wearables are not a route, they enrich the daily note (HR/sleep/strain auto-added to symptom+med+feeling entries).

items.observation: Adoption-depth North Star refinement ('every other NL oncology patient uses Ditto within a week of diagnosis' style metrics) parked for later. Merlijn: 'super interesting' but not now.
items.suggested_action: Revisit after the core-action decision lands; define the depth metric against the chosen beachhead.

items.observation: Installs driven by the kanker.nl Appstore listing are invisible: the store links to Ditto carry no UTM/attribution, and kanker.nl click data was never requested. Channel value (distribution lever vs trust badge) is unquantified.
items.suggested_action: Ask kanker.nl (appstore@kanker.nl) for listing click stats and whether UTM-tagged store links are allowed; fold into the broader Adjust/Mixpanel attribution work.
